answer_1.quote: We propose an approach that can automatically suggest comment updates when the associated methods are changed.
datasets: a corpus constructed from open-source Java projects on GitHub
models: encoder-decoder architecture with GRUs and attention mechanism

answer_2.quote: We compute exact match... We also report two prevailing language generation metrics: METEOR , and average sentence-level BLEU-4 ... SARI ... GLEU

answer_4.quote: We also conduct human evaluation... User study design: Our study aims to reflect how a comment update system would be used in practice... by asking a user to select the most appropriate updated comment from a list of suggestions... Nine students... and one full-time developer... participated in our study.
answer_4.guideline: Users select the most appropriate updated comment from suggestions, given the code diff and old comment.
